summary: A single open tab in the browser's tab strip.
description: A single browser tab: icon, title label, audio/sharing/note indicators, and close button. A customized built-in element extending the toolkit <tab> element (is="tabbrowser-tab"); builds its light-DOM structure once from a static template and drives it via an attribute-inheritance map.

attributes.name: pinned
attributes.description: Whether the tab is pinned to the start of the tabstrip.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Whether the tab is the active tab; set via the internal _selected setter, actual selection is driven by gBrowser.

attributes.name: multiselected
attributes.description: Whether the tab is part of a multi-selection.

attributes.name: muted
attributes.description: Whether audio playback on the tab is muted.

attributes.name: soundplaying
attributes.description: Whether the tab is currently playing audio.

attributes.name: pictureinpicture
attributes.description: Whether the tab has an active picture-in-picture window.

attributes.name: activemedia-blocked
attributes.description: Whether autoplay media on the tab was blocked.

attributes.name: usercontextid
attributes.description: The container (contextual identity) id the tab belongs to.

attributes.name: undiscardable
attributes.description: Whether the tab is protected from automatic memory-saving discard.

attributes.name: attention
attributes.description: Whether the tab is showing an attention dot (e.g. a background alert).

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: The tab's title text, inherited onto the internal .tab-label element.

attributes.name: tab-note
attributes.description: Whether the tab has an attached note, backed by the hasTabNote getter/setter.

attributes.name: visuallyselected
attributes.description: Internal e10s tab-switch visual state, distinct from logical selection.

attributes.name: busy
attributes.description: Internal loading-state flag driving the throbber.

attributes.name: bursting
attributes.description: Internal flag driving the throbber's completion "burst" animation.

attributes.name: textoverflow
attributes.description: Internal CSS hook for label text-overflow fade direction.

attributes.name: soundplaying-scheduledremoval
attributes.description: Internal grace-period flag before the sound icon is removed; drives --soundplaying-removal-delay.

attributes.name: customizemode
attributes.description: Internal state reflecting whether the browser is in toolbar customize mode.

events.name: TabHoverStart
events.description: Bubbling Event dispatched from an internal mouseenter handler when the pointer enters the tab.

events.name: TabHoverEnd
events.description: Bubbling Event dispatched from an internal mouseleave handler.

events.name: TabNoteIconHoverStart
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent with detail {noteIconElement}, dispatched when the pointer enters the tab-note icon.

events.name: TabNoteIconHoverEnd
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent with detail {returningToTab}, dispatched when the pointer leaves the tab-note icon.

events.name: TabGrouped
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent dispatched on the tab's new tab-group (detail: the tab) when the tab newly belongs to that group.

events.name: TabUngrouped
events.description: Bubbling CustomEvent dispatched on the tab-group being left (detail: the tab) when the tab leaves it.

cssProperties.name: --tab-border-color-accent
cssProperties.description: Accent border color (e.g. for group color).

cssProperties.name: --tab-label-line-height
cssProperties.description: Line height of the tab label.

cssProperties.name: --tab-label-mask-size
cssProperties.description: Mask size used for label text-overflow fade.

cssProperties.name: --tab-loading-fill
cssProperties.description: Fill color of the loading throbber.

cssProperties.name: --tab-dragover-outline-color
cssProperties.description: Outline color while a drag hovers over the tab.

cssProperties.name: --tab-width-transition
cssProperties.description: Transition used when tab width changes (open/close animation).

cssProperties.name: --tab-context-line-block-offset
cssProperties.description: Offset of the group color context line.

cssProperties.name: --tab-context-line-inline-offset
cssProperties.description: Inline offset of the group color context line.

cssProperties.name: --tab-context-line-split-view-block-offset
cssProperties.description: Context-line offset variant for split-view tabs.

cssProperties.name: --tab-collapsed-width
cssProperties.description: Width of a tab collapsed into an overflow container (e.g. collapsed group).

cssProperties.name: --tab-collapsed-background-width
cssProperties.description: Background width of a collapsed tab.

cssProperties.name: --tab-collapsed-split-pill-offset
cssProperties.description: Offset for the collapsed split-view pill indicator.

usage: <tab is="tabbrowser-tab" label="Example Domain" pinned usercontextid="1" soundplaying="true"></tab>
